description: Sewer Pump Station (WCORP-295) is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Water Corporation. The Water Corporation layer is a spatial representation of a Sewer Pump Station. A pumping station is a facility used to force sewerage along a section of the sewer network. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Water Corporation. Its tags are Infrastructure, Sewer Pump Station, Utilities, Wastewater, Water Corporation. It offers 8 resource(s) in API ARCGIS SERVER MAP SERVICE, FGDB, GEOJSON, GEOPACKAGE, PDF. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is custom_other. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
